northpoint: Make every AI conversation, project, idea, status, generated artifact, and recovery path instantly findable while keeping the original performance engine aggressive, invisible, and quality-preserving.
pillars: performance engine remains first class
zero-tab deep cataloging
premium full-page searchable Home
exact chat and artifact lineage
durable local plus Google Drive continuity
multi-provider adapters with truthful coverage
real-runtime verification before flawless claims
provider-independent projects, nested groups, smart collections, tags, and bulk organization
organization survives Drive checkpoint/journal restore without overwriting provider source lineage
professional configurable Workbench UI combining conversational simplicity with IDE-grade workspace control
persistent editor tabs, Explorer, contextual Inspector, operations panel, status bar, command palette, and saved layouts
Approval Autopilot prevents connector-consent stalls and stale/paused chats from silently stranding projects
one-click all-known recovery plus targeted always-on stale-chat recovery
adaptive request governance prevents provider throttling from becoming a browser or catalog failure
Project Integrity continuously detects version drift, artifact conflicts, project rollback, regressions, and unfinished follow-ups without model/API traffic
delivery/connection timeouts recover by browser refresh and never by pressing provider Retry controls

Knowledge Vault turns every useful AI recommendation, link, code reference, command, decision, follow-up, version, mod/package resource, and artifact into searchable source-attributed project knowledge
Live Chat Health exposes truthful current-chat progress, tool/network activity, stalls, stale tabs, render degradation, recovery state, and Project Integrity directly on supported AI pages
Conversation Capacity Guard warns before large chats become continuity risks and offers one-click Safe Handoff without claiming an exact provider context ceiling

Execution Pulse + Tool Watchdog must tell whether a chat is actively producing model/tool/network proof, merely quiet, stuck on a tool/request, or apparently dead without trusting a zombie pending request.
guardrails: automatic/default cataloging never creates crawler tabs; Approval Autopilot may use exactly one minimized recovery tab after explicit user enablement, while manual Full Capture may use exactly one visible capture window
never trim, hide, delete, replace, or second-virtualize conversation turns
AI-page content scripts never perform network requests
background collection is incremental and never blocks provider UI work
provider credentials stay outside content contexts
metadata-only collection is never labeled full transcript coverage
native provider behavior wins on failure
Constellation organization is additive; never overwrite or erase original provider project/source metadata
large-history organizer views use indexed counts and bounded/chunked writes rather than transcript scans
workspace chrome may never add work to AI provider page render/input paths
every visible Workbench control must change real navigation, layout, selection, search, sync, recovery, or persisted workspace state
layout customization must persist safely and remain keyboard-operable without sacrificing compact performance
no visible control may ship without a real handler, backend owner, observable result, and truthful failure state
identity OAuth may never be presented as chat-history access when the provider does not grant conversation history
long Full Capture DOM work belongs to the capture page; the service worker only orchestrates restart-safe short steps
missing product OAuth credentials must surface as setup required rather than fake connection success
Approval Autopilot must require explicit acknowledgement plus enablement and must keep every automated recovery auditable in chat/activity state
stale detection must be based on semantic activity, never a fresh ingest timestamp
recovery must use bounded retries/timeouts and one reusable tab rather than spawning a tab swarm
delivery timeout / connection interrupted recovery is browser refresh only; provider Retry controls are never part of the recovery action set
provider 429/Too many requests creates one shared cooldown across background catalog and hidden recovery; the recovery window closes until cooldown expires
same-provider HTTP collection must be single-flight and freshness-aware; global Connections refresh may not fan out network probes
official full-export coverage is authoritative bootstrap data and may not be periodically re-fetched without evidence of change
Project Integrity defaults to deterministic local analysis; do not spend model/API requests merely to decide whether a project needs attention
knowledge extraction must be local, incremental, content-fingerprinted, deduplicated, idle-aware for historical backfill, and may not create provider/API traffic merely to organize captured data
Live Chat Health may passively observe provider request lifecycle in the background but may not intercept bodies/headers, block requests, or add provider-page network calls
stale-tab refresh warnings require authoritative/newer evidence and must not infer corruption from partial or metadata-only catalog snapshots
a quiet tool/chat with a real in-flight provider request is active, not stalled; stall classification requires absence of semantic DOM/tool/network progress beyond threshold
project continuation starts from the newest verified full Google Drive source/artifact/checkpoint; GitHub, sandbox, and File Library are supplemental rather than Drive substitutes

material project outputs are published to Google Drive in full and remotely verified; manifests, hashes, receipts, diffs, patches, and partial recovery fragments never substitute for the complete deliverable
Conversation Capacity Guard uses configurable proactive local thresholds plus explicit provider limit signals and never claims an exact provider token/context ceiling
Safe Handoff preserves exact source lineage and full catalog durability; it may copy a compact continuation index but may never discard or replace full captured history

a pending request is evidence only while it shows bounded recent lifecycle/DOM/tool progress; a zombie open request must transition through request-stalled/dead rather than remaining healthy indefinitely
